title: About
text:
Why data science
After five years of architecting Data and AI solutions at scale, pursuing a Master’s in Data Science is about elevating practice into precision. I am using this degree to hone my core skills in advanced statistical modeling, machine learning, and deep analytics—building on my solid engineering foundation to solve complex, high-stakes data problems from the ground up.

title: About
text:
Outside of data science
When I’m not immersed in code and statistical models, you’ll usually find me exploring my creative and active sides. I’m a passionate painter and love creating art, whether I’m sketching or working with acrylics. On weekends, I balance quiet time with movement—you’ll often find me reading novels, hitting the badminton court for a fast-paced game, or exploring new spots as an enthusiastic foodie who loves trying cuisines from all over the world. To unwind through it all, I love playing classic Indian music in the background.

title: Anushka Seth
text: Hi there! I am currently a Master of Data Science (MDS) student at the University of British Columbia, based in beautiful Vancouver. Prior to joining UBC, I spent five years working as a Data and AI Consultant at Microsoft, where I gained hands-on experience building enterprise data pipelines and AI solutions. With a background in Computer Science, I joined the MDS program to further sharpen my technical foundation, deepen my data science expertise, and explore new tools and methods in the field.
